title: OpenStax — the open textbooks
body: The OpenStax open textbooks — calculus, physics, chemistry, biology, astronomy, anatomy, economics and more — peer-reviewed college texts released free to all under CC-BY 4.0. Gathered and credited, section by section: modern mathematics and theory for the reference section, free to reuse with attribution.
